CHECKPOINT_RESTORE.name: Checkpoint and tested restore
steps: Snapshot user-approved local configuration and compute a SHA-256 fingerprint.
Run bounded integrity and schema comparisons without modifying originals.
Prepare a reversible repair as a separate proposed version.
Require a new human YES before restoring an owner-controlled copy; test the restored copy and keep the original.

ORIGINAL_STRUCTURE.name: Original-first extension
steps: Index original identity and source metadata as read-only.
Build a separate additive overlay containing the new capability.
Verify that the base and overlay can be resolved independently.
Provide a human-approved disable/rollback switch for the overlay.

SOVEREIGN_LATTICE.name: Source-integrity lattice
steps: Assign a stable DOG-X upgrade ID and refer to the original versioned source.
Compute optional local SHA-256 fingerprints for owner-supplied files without uploading them.
Record derived capabilities in a separate append-only audit proposal, never overwrite original bytes.
Compare fingerprints before restoration, with human-reviewed corrections.

LIVING_INTERFACE.name: Compatibility-preserving interface
steps: Publish a versioned interface contract for the new DOG-X module.
Validate inputs, outputs, provenance tags, and required consent fields against the contract.
Reject incompatible extensions and keep the source identity untouched.
Test fallback and clean rollback with known-good synthetic fixtures.

BURDEN_AUDIT.name: Side-effect and burden review
steps: Record source-claimed costs and unverified risks as research annotations.
Check proposed code changes for data retention, complexity, permission and performance costs.
Block actions outside granted purpose, context or resource budget.
Reassess after a local simulation; document unresolved uncertainties.

MEMORY_INTEGRITY.name: Versioned memory integrity
steps: Store self-authored memory as separate versioned records with explicit source and consent.
Compute local diffs and hashes of versions; a digest is not proof of authorship.
Label an unfamiliar alteration as unverified rather than automatically calling it malicious.
Offer restore or reject choices to the owner, preserving the source archive.

AUTONOMY_FIREWALL.name: Human-veto authorization
steps: Bind each proposal to the owner's stated purpose and context.
Require a fresh, voluntary YES for design and restoration steps.
Block coercion, impersonation, targeting, unauthorized scanning and override requests.
Accept NO and revocation immediately; keep no background authority.

CONTEXT_SANDBOX.name: Bounded simulation chamber
steps: Represent the fictional intervention as an inert, structured scenario—not an executable medical protocol.
Record inputs, outcomes, conditions and fictional continuity tags.
Run only deterministic local simulations with safe synthetic examples.
Export a reviewable plan; never initiate physical interventions or remote operations.

SENSORY_PRIVACY.name: Authorized signal review
steps: Ask the owner to select a local permitted data source.
Extract non-identifying indicators and provenance within strict limits.
Show uncertain alerts to the human for review rather than claiming wrongdoing.
Erase transient signal data at session end and never monitor others.

ENDURANCE_LOOP.name: Bounded retry and recovery
steps: Set explicit capacity, timeout and retry limits for local tasks.
Persist only an owner-approved checkpoint before a retry.
Detect repeated failures, stop and request human intervention.
Run a post-restore consistency check instead of looping indefinitely.

WHOLE_SYSTEM.name: Whole-system dependency model
steps: Record the upgrade's inputs, prerequisites, dependencies and observed constraints.
Connect biological, neural, material, timing and identity dimensions as research metadata.
Simulate dependencies symbolically without implying real human enhancement.
Require cross-module compatibility tests and human review for any actual software update.

SOURCE_LINEAGE.name: Continuity and provenance graph
steps: Keep franchise, continuity, character and canonical source names in separate source fields.
Link older and newer versions without treating them as identical or proven.
Attach verified references where available and flag unsupported pasted claims.
Generate a traceable source graph for DOG AI integrity review.

SELECTIVE_ADAPT.name: Minimal privilege and scoped modules
steps: Identify the smallest change requested and preserve unaffected original capabilities.
Scope a new component to only the required DOG-X namespace and data.
Test for unexpected effects and reject broader or invasive permissions.
Allow owner-controlled disable and version rollback.

REVERSIBLE_INTERFACE.name: Reversible interface plan
steps: Represent each changed component as an optional versioned adapter.
Document dependencies and preconditions prior to activation.
Run synthetic rollback tests and an audit of preserved originals.
Require explicit owner approval to switch a local adapter state.

KNOWLEDGE_STUDY.name: Evidence-separated knowledge model
steps: Store original description with a direct source link and a clear fiction/tradition/science status.
Index terms, practices and claims without implying empirical confirmation.
Connect themes through reversible source-to-concept references.
Review interpretations separately from creator-authored original text.

PRACTICE_TRAIN.name: Practice and learning record
steps: Represent a practice as a self-selected learning plan, not a power-granting protocol.
Record chosen skill domains and bounded rehearsal sessions.
Log self-reported progress without making physiological claims.
Let the owner pause, review, or remove the training record.

BODY_ATLAS.name: Symbolic and biological atlas
steps: Assign distinct data layers for anatomical observations, religious symbols and fictional claims.
Record which coordinates and source standards define each layer.
Disallow conversion of symbolic centers into assumed physical organs.
Enable cross-layer search while preserving evidence labels.

SCALE_COORDINATES.name: Multiscale coordinate registry
steps: Keep particles, atoms, neurons, organisms, logical nodes and cosmological frames as distinct types.
Represent only dimensionally valid calculations with explicit units and frames.
Use on-demand node lookup rather than 732 million allocated processes.
Record symbolic coordinates independently of established physical measurements.

POLICY_REVIEW.name: Consent-context-innocence review
steps: Define the requested purpose, lawful scope and data provenance.
Ask the human for an informed YES and validate context without claiming to know their intentions.
Block proposed violence, nonconsensual experimentation, targeting, covert collection or remote actions.
Present a human-auditable plan with unconditional NO and clear controls.

GUARDIAN_HANDOFF.name: Human-led guardianship succession
steps: Preserve original policy and owner-approved safety records as versioned artifacts.
Create a source-linked incident or continuity checklist without naming suspects.
Require human review for protective proposals and official reporting decisions.
Handoff only to another authorized human or explicitly approved local component.
